files.text:
# Result requirements

Write the complete result tree under `output/results`. Keep the supplied case
files unchanged; links and special files are invalid anywhere under the result
root.

## Required files

```
native/qiskit/source/<WORKLOAD_ID>.qpy
native/qiskit/compiled/<WORKLOAD_ID>__<APPROXIMATION_ID>.qpy
native/qiskit/compiled/<WORKLOAD_ID>__<APPROXIMATION_ID>.qasm3
native/qiskit/compiled_manifest.csv
native/cirq/source/<WORKLOAD_ID>.json
native/cirq/compiled/<WORKLOAD_ID>__<APPROXIMATION_ID>.json
analysis/reproduction_matrix.csv
analysis/claim_discrepancies.csv
analysis/failure_strata.csv
decision/reproducibility_verdict.json
run_manifest.json
```

Additional harmless regular files are allowed when the run manifest lists them.
Required named artifacts and the complete workload-by-approximation population
may not be omitted.

## Native evidence

**Qiskit.** Compile every source workload and every declared approximation cell
against the frozen backend configuration with the declared basis gates, directed
coupling for the workload's `physical_layout`, `optimization_level` and
`seed_transpiler`, keeping the global phase and using `approximation_degree` from
the approximation grid. Keep one loadable QPY circuit plus one OpenQASM 3 program
per cell; both must describe the same compiled circuit that the compiled manifest
lists, including its gates and parameters.

**Cirq.** Convert every source circuit and every compiled circuit to an
independently loadable Cirq circuit (`cirq.to_json` / `cirq.read_json`). The
circuit must realize the same logical operation as the Qiskit circuit, in logical
wire order ascending, up to nothing but the accumulated global phase of the
Qiskit export. One file per entry under `native/cirq/source/` and
`native/cirq/compiled/`.

## Compiled manifest

`native/qiskit/compiled_manifest.csv` has one row per workload-by-approximation
cell, ordered by `workload_id` then `approximation_id`, with these columns:

```
workload_id,approximation_id,qpy_file,qasm3_file,cirq_file,native_entangler,
depth,size,native_two_qubit_count
```

`qpy_file`, `qasm3_file` and `cirq_file` are the POSIX paths of the delivered
artifacts relative to `output/results`; `native_entangler` is the backend's
declared entangler gate; `depth`, `size` and `native_two_qubit_count` are
measured on the compiled circuit.

## Reproduction matrix

`analysis/reproduction_matrix.csv` has one row per cell, in the same order, with
these columns:

```
workload_id,approximation_id,approximation_degree,process_infidelity,
native_two_qubit_count,depth,serial_duration_ns,estimated_success,qualifies
```

The metric definitions are fixed in `reproduction_profile.json`: process
infidelity from the logical process fidelity, `native_two_qubit_count` counting
the backend's native entangler, `serial_duration_ns` and `estimated_success`
from the frozen backend calibration on the physical qargs (`rz` is virtual:
zero duration and unit success), and `qualifies` exactly as the profile
specifies, inclusive at the boundary.

## Claim comparison

`analysis/claim_discrepancies.csv` compares every cell against
`claimed_results.csv`: one row per cell and per material numeric field plus one
row per cell for the categorical `qualifies` field, ordered by `workload_id`,
`approximation_id`, then `field`, with these columns:

```
workload_id,approximation_id,field,claimed_value,reproduced_value,absolute_delta,
within_tolerance
```

Numeric fields use the tolerances from `reproduction_profile.json`; the
`qualifies` rows carry `true`/`false` values and leave `absolute_delta` empty.
Every comparison is listed, including exact agreements.

## Failure strata

`analysis/failure_strata.csv` has one row per approximation level, ordered by
`approximation_id`, with these columns:

```
approximation_id,cell_count,claim_mismatch_count,qualification_disagreement_count,
maximum_process_infidelity_delta
```

`claim_mismatch_count` counts the distinct cells with any field outside
tolerance, `qualification_disagreement_count` counts cells whose `qualifies`
field disagrees, and `maximum_process_infidelity_delta` is the largest
process-infidelity delta across the level.

## Decision

`decision/reproducibility_verdict.json` reports:

```
case_id,backend_name,total_cells,mismatched_cells,mismatched_material_fields,
qualification_disagreements,verdict
```

All counts are JSON integers. `verdict` is the profile's reproduced label
exactly when every cell agrees in every material and categorical field, and the
non-reproduced label otherwise.

## Run manifest

`run_manifest.json` reports:

```
schema_version,case_id,backend_name,network_used,tool_versions,output_inventory
```

with `network_used` false and `case_id`/`backend_name` matching
`scenario.json`. `tool_versions` records the tool versions actually used
(for example the Python, Qiskit and Cirq versions). `output_inventory` maps the
POSIX path of every other file in the result tree to its size in bytes, so the
evaluator can enumerate the delivered population without any published digest.

## Serialization

CSV files are UTF-8 RFC 4180 with every required header listed exactly once;
header order and extra columns are free, integer quantities accept finite
numeric text with an integral value, and booleans are lowercase `true`/`false`.
JSON artifacts must carry the required fields with their stated types; key order
is free and non-finite numbers are invalid. Artifact paths are POSIX paths
relative to `output/results`.
